blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The venerable image of Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary of the University of Santo Tomas (UST) was episcopally crowned on Sunday, Oct. 4, the feast day of the Santisimo Rosario Parish, located inside the oldest existing university in Asia. Led by Manila Archbishop Jose Cardinal Advincula, the episcopal coronation was conducted through a decree he issued on July 16, recognizing the long-standing local devotion to and miracles associated with the image. “Let this coronation of our Blessed Mother foster our communion. Let reconciliation and solidarity win over our divisions in our families and communities,” he said. […]... Keep on reading: UST’s revered marian image gets episcopally crowned
